parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: This is a wheel of the trashcan, made of rubber, typically circular with a diameter of about 20 cm.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the trashcan to be moved easily by rolling on the ground.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its central axle to enable movement of the trashcan.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: This is the second wheel of the trashcan, made of rubber, identical to the first wheel.
parts.Functional_description: It works together with the other wheel to balance and roll the trashcan smoothly.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its central axle, synchronized with the opposite wheel.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of the trashcan, made of HDPE plastic, rectangular in shape and hinged to the body.
parts.Functional_description: It covers the opening of the trashcan to contain waste and prevent odor escape.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate upward around the hinge to open and downward to close.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the trashcan, made of HDPE plastic, forming the container for waste storage.
parts.Functional_description: It holds and supports the waste, providing structural integrity to the trashcan.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while the wheels and lid move; it can tilt when the trashcan is rolled.
